rationale: This record keyed the legacy MCP endpoint request-outcome and request-duration metric families, which have no meaning in the MCP-free baseline.
This record keyed the legacy stateful MCP session-duration metric family by endpoint and termination reason, both removed with session-era MCP.
This record keyed termination metrics for legacy MCP-specific SSE streams and is not used by Soklet's independent SSE server metrics.
This log event existed only to report failure of the removed didCreateMcpSession lifecycle callback.
This log event existed only to report failure of the removed didEstablishMcpSseStream lifecycle callback.
This log event existed only to report failure of the removed didFinishMcpRequestHandling lifecycle callback.
This log event existed only to report failure of the removed didStartMcpRequestHandling lifecycle callback.
This log event existed only to report failure of the removed didTerminateMcpSession lifecycle callback.
This log event existed only to report failure of the removed didTerminateMcpSseStream lifecycle callback.
This log event existed only to report failure of the removed willTerminateMcpSseStream lifecycle callback.
This enum constant selected the deleted legacy MCP listener/server mode and was never used for Soklet's HTTP or SSE server types.
This termination reason represented closure of a legacy stateful MCP session and does not describe any non-MCP SSE termination path.
This factory supplied identifiers exclusively for legacy MCP sessions; the MCP-free baseline has no framework session-ID facility.
This callback observed creation of a legacy stateful MCP session and has no non-MCP lifecycle event to report.
This callback observed establishment of the deleted McpSseStream abstraction, not Soklet's independent SSE server streams.
This callback reported startup failure for the deleted legacy McpServer and cannot apply once that server type is removed.
This callback reported shutdown failure for the deleted legacy McpServer and cannot apply once that server type is removed.
This callback exposed legacy MCP endpoint, session, JSON-RPC, and outcome types after MCP request handling completed.
This callback exposed legacy MCP endpoint, session, method, and JSON-RPC request identifiers when MCP handling began.
This callback observed successful startup of the deleted legacy McpServer and has no HTTP-server analogue under this signature.
This callback observed successful shutdown of the deleted legacy McpServer and has no HTTP-server analogue under this signature.
This callback reported duration and reason for a legacy stateful MCP session termination, a lifecycle removed in the clean baseline.
This callback reported completion of the deleted MCP-specific SSE stream abstraction rather than a generic Soklet SSE stream.
This callback ran only before startup of the deleted legacy McpServer and cannot be invoked in the MCP-free baseline.
This callback ran only before shutdown of the deleted legacy McpServer and cannot be invoked in the MCP-free baseline.
This callback ran only before termination of the deleted MCP-specific SSE stream abstraction.
This metrics callback incremented legacy MCP session and connection observations when a stateful MCP session was created.
This metrics callback tracked establishment of deleted MCP-specific SSE streams, separate from the surviving SSE server metrics.
This metrics callback recorded outcome and duration for the deleted legacy MCP request pipeline using MCP-only key and result types.
This metrics callback tracked entry into the deleted legacy MCP request pipeline using endpoint, session, method, and JSON-RPC identifiers.
This metrics callback recorded duration and outcome of a legacy stateful MCP session, which the clean baseline no longer owns.
This metrics callback recorded termination of deleted MCP-specific SSE streams and is unrelated to generic SSE transport accounting.
This snapshot getter exposed the active legacy MCP session gauge, which is removed with stateful MCP session management.
This snapshot getter exposed the active legacy MCP-specific SSE stream gauge, not the surviving generic SSE stream gauge.
This snapshot getter exposed accepted connection counts for the deleted legacy MCP server listener.
This snapshot getter exposed rejected connection counts for the deleted legacy MCP server listener.
This snapshot getter exposed duration histograms keyed by the removed legacy MCP endpoint request-outcome record.
This snapshot getter exposed request-read failures from the deleted legacy MCP transport pipeline.
This snapshot getter exposed request rejections produced by the deleted legacy MCP server path.
This snapshot getter exposed request totals keyed by the removed legacy MCP endpoint request-outcome record.
This snapshot getter exposed duration histograms keyed by the removed legacy MCP session-termination record.
This snapshot getter exposed duration histograms keyed by the removed MCP-specific SSE stream-termination record.
This snapshot builder setter populated the removed active legacy MCP session gauge.
This snapshot builder setter populated the removed active MCP-specific SSE stream gauge.
This snapshot builder setter populated accepted connection counts for the deleted legacy MCP listener.
This snapshot builder setter populated rejected connection counts for the deleted legacy MCP listener.
This snapshot builder setter populated duration histograms keyed by the removed MCP endpoint request-outcome record.
This snapshot builder setter populated request-read failures from the deleted legacy MCP transport pipeline.
This snapshot builder setter populated request rejections from the deleted legacy MCP server path.
This snapshot builder setter populated request totals keyed by the removed MCP endpoint request-outcome record.
This snapshot builder setter populated duration histograms keyed by the removed MCP session-termination record.
This snapshot builder setter populated duration histograms keyed by the removed MCP-specific SSE stream-termination record.
This simulator hook configured error handling only for replayed legacy MCP stream messages and has no generic HTTP/SSE role.
This simulator operation invoked the deleted legacy MCP request path and returned the deleted McpRequestResult model.
This protected hook dispatched requests into the deleted legacy MCP processor and exposed no behavior used by normal HTTP handling.
This protected hook simulated disconnection of a legacy session-bound MCP stream and has no role in ordinary SSE disconnect handling.
This accessor exposed the deleted legacy McpServer from the shared Soklet configuration.
This factory began shared configuration with the deleted legacy McpServer as its MCP-only input.
This builder method installed the deleted legacy McpServer into Soklet configuration.
This copier method replaced the deleted legacy McpServer while copying Soklet configuration.
